code_objects.name: is_load_audit_loading_issue_screen
constants:
'Detect the item-level Load Audit EFL confirm screen that means the loaded quantity is wrong.

This screen appears after LOAD ID, GATE PASS ID, and LOCATION were accepted, but before the
expected Y/N prompt. It usually shows Order/Item/Ordered/Picked/Loaded lines, a textbox, a
bottom Submit button, and a Confirm hint. When it appears we should submit it once, mark the
row as Loding Issue, and continue with the next Load ID.
'
